question: Choose the correct meaning of Idiom **"Bite the bullet**".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Endure something painful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Bite the bullet"** means to endure a painful or otherwise unpleasant situation that is unavoidable. (कठिन परिस्थिति को सहन करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to bite the bullet and accept the job offer, even though it meant relocating to a new city.
 
 

 
• **"Endure"** refers to the ability to tolerate or withstand something unpleasant or difficult. (सहन करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She endured the long hours of study to achieve her dreams.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **"Bite the bullet"** aligns with the meaning of enduring something painful or difficult.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Make a bold plan** (साहसी योजना बनाना) - This means to come up with a daring or courageous plan.

 
 
• **Example:** The team made a bold plan to climb the highest mountain peak.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Speak without thinking** (सोचे बिना बोलना) - This refers to speaking impulsively without considering the consequences.
 
 
• **Example:** He often gets into trouble because he speaks without thinking.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Tell a secret** (राज़ बताना) - This means to reveal confidential or private information.
 
 
• **Example:** She accidentally told a secret that she had promised to keep.
 
 

78:Tc31,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.</d
